book.name: HECHOS
book.title: Jesuspa Cachran Ruragcuna Rurapäcunganpita Isquirbisha Libru

content: Mandagcuna Pedrowan Juanta manchachiyta munapäcungan
Chaynuypa Pedrowan Juan chay goturarcayag runacunata rimaparcayaptinmi chrarärimun sacerdöticuna, Diospa wayinta ricag guardiacunapa mandagnin, jinaman saduceocuna.
Chaycunaga alisca piñasha chrarärimun Pedrowan Juan “Jesucristoga razonpam cawacämusha, chaura cananga paynuymi noganchis cawacämushun” nir yachrachipäcuptinmi.
Chaura Pedrotawan Juantaga aywachicurcan carcelmanmi. Jinarcurmi nä pacha chacanaptinga wichrgarärira warantincama.
Nätan Jesuspita rimapäcunganta mayacug runacunaga Jesusta chrasquicurcasha achcam. Chay chrasquicushacuna capäcura pichga waranganuymi olgola.
Chaura warantinga, gotucarärin chay Jerusalén marcachru mandagcunam, Israel castachru alinninpag ricasha chacha runacunam, Moisés isquirbinganta yachrachigcunam.
Jinaman capäcuratan sacerdöticunapa mas mandagnincunas. Paycuna capäcura Anasmi, Caifasmi. Nätan Juanwan Alejandroga capäcura paycuna castam.
Chaura Pedrotawan Juantaga carcelpita pusharcachimurmi chraupincunaman shayarärichin. Jinarcurmi tapupäcura cay nir: “Gamcunaga, ¿pi nirärishuptiquitag cay rata runata cutirärichinqui?”
Nipäcuptinmi Pedroga Santu Espíritu rimachiptin cay nirun: “Cay marcachru mandagcuna, jinaman alinninpag ricasha Israel casta taytacuna,
¿cay rata runata cuticächipäcungäpitachu juc juchäcushata yupaysi tapuparcayämanqui?
Chaura nipäcushay caychru lapan Israel castanchicuna musyapäcunanpag: Cay runa cuticarayan Jesucristopa munayninwanmi. Paytam gamcunaga cruzchru wanuchipäcuray, jinatam Tayta Diosga cawacächimusha.
Chay Jesustam gamcunaga mana chrasquicurcaraychu, wayi ruragcuna
Chay wicapasha ruminuysi cayag Jesusmi, cananga cayan chay mas alinnincag ruminuy”.
Nircurmi “Manam pisi canchu cay pachachru runacunata salvananpag. Manatan Tayta Diosga pitas nishapishchu salvamänanchipagsi, antis nirayanga Jesuslatam” nirun.

Chaura Pedrowan Juan mana mancharilar chay nir rimapäcuptinga, Israel castacunapa mandagnincunaga mayacasha niragmi ricacarärin leyiytas ni isquirbiytas mana yachrapäcunganta musyarärirga. Nätan regueräriratagmi Jesuswan purig capäcungantas.
Chauraga Pedrotawan Juanta juchachayta munarsi manam ima niytas atipapäcurachu, chaychru chay cuticasha runa paycunawan shayaptin.
Chauraga Pedrotawan Juantam “Caypita rätula yargapäcuy” nirärin quiquincamala chay runacuna rimanacurcänanpag.

Chauraga cay ninacurcaram: “¿Imatatag chay olgocunawan rurashun? Paycunaga runala mana ruray atipänantam rurararcayan. Chaytaga cay Jerusalenchrüga lapanmi musyarcayan. Nätan ‘Chayga yangam’ niytaga manam atipanchichu.
Antis chay runacunata nirushun manchachiypa mana masta cay marcachru pitas Jesuspita willapacurcänanpag”.
Ninacarcärirmi Pedrotawan Juanta gayarcachir cay nirärin: “Cananpitaga ama pasay rimapäcuypishchu ni yachrachipäcuypishchu Jesuspitaga”.
Niräriptinga Pedrowan Juanga cay nirärinmi: “¿Gamcunapitaga Diosta cäsucuychu ali u runacunata cäsucuychu?
Nätan nogacunaga chaynuylam rimarcayäshag ricapapäcungätaga mayapäcungätaga”.

Chaura chaynuypa niräriptinga chay mandagcunaga cachrarirärira mas manchachiypa nircärirmi. Nätan ima ruraytas mana atipapäcurachu Jerusalenchru lapan yachragcuna chay pasanganpita Diosta alawapäcuptinmi.
Jinaman chay cuticasha runas nämi aywayara chruscu chrunca watapita masta.
Diosman yupachicugcuna Diosta manacurcangan

Chaypita nä cachrariräriptinga, Pedrowan Juanga Jesusman yupachicug-mayincunamanmi aywacurcan. Chrarurga willapacarärin chay sacerdöticunapa mandagnincuna, Israel castachru alinninpag ricasha chacha runacuna manchachiypa nipäcungantam.

Willaparäriptinga Diosman yupachicugcunaga Tayta Diostam manacuyta lapalan galacayärin cay nir: “Munayniyog Diosnïcuna, gammi camaray jana pachatas cay pachatas jatun gochratas, jinaman chaycunachru lapan ima-aygatas.
Gampa servigniqui Rey Davidga unaylam Santu Espíritu rimachiptin Jesuspa contran sharcapäcunanpita cay nira:

content.text: ‘¿Imanirtag lapan casta runacuna lutanta rurananpag sucsutänacurcan,

content: Chay ningaynuylam cay Jerusalén marcachru Rey Herodesga, Romapita mandag Poncio Pilatowan, juc casta runacunawan Israelpa mandagnincunawan gotucapäcusha, gam acrangay mana juchaynag servigniqui Jesusta wanuchipäcunanpag.
Chaynuy rurar paycunaga rurarärira gam unaypita chaynuy ruracänanpag pinsiangaynuylam.
Munayniyog Dios chay mandagcuna manchachiypa nipäcamanganpita musyayanquim. Nätan nogacuna cay servigniquicunata yanapapäcamay gampita mana manchacular willapacurcänäpag.
Chaynuytag yanapapäcamay munayniquiwan gueshyagcunata cuticächipäcunäpag, jinaman runala mana ruray atipänanta rurapäcushag mana juchaynag servigniqui Jesús nipäcamangannuyla” nirärin.

Chaura Tayta Diosta nä manacuyta usharäriptinga, chay goturarcayangan wayiga cuyurunmi. Jinarcurmi chayla Santu Espiritupa munayninchru ricacarärin. Chaypitam Diospa willapanta rimapäcura mana manchacular.
Caynuymi cawapäcura Jesusman yupachicug gotucagcuna

Chaura Jesusman chay yupachicugcunaga alisca chranin carcayarsi, cawapäcura juc shongolam, jinaman munapäcugsi ali ruraytam lapansi. Chaymi mana maygansi “Cayga nogapam” nigchu imantas, antis “Cayga lapanchipam” nipäcug.

Nätan Jesuspa cachran ruragcunaga Dios yanapaptin mana pasay mancharilarmi Munayniyog Jesús cawacämunganpita rimapäcug. Jinapäcuptin Tayta Diosga Jesusman lapan yupachicugcunata aliscam yanapara ima-aygatas rurapäcunanpag.
Manam paycunachru pisi carachu imapitas nacatacug. Capunganpitam chracrancunatas, wayincunatas ranticurcurga, golgueta apapäcug Jesuspa cachran ruragcunata gopäcunanpag.
Goräriptinga paycunam chay golgueta aypupäcug lapan chaychru cagcunata ushapanganpita imancunatas rantipäcunanpag.
Chaynuymi Josësi rurara. Payta Jesuspa cachran ruragcuna jutiparärira “Bernabé” nirmi. ‘Bernabé’ ninanga ‘Cushicachicug’ ninanmi. Payga cara Levïpa castanmi, Chipre tishgopita.
Chaura paysi juc chracran cayagta ranticurcurmi golgueta gorura Jesuspa cachran ruragcunata.
